acceptance: Journey, red first: a lane changes its inbox item, the plane stamps the same file on main, and the ship rebase lands the lane with both changes kept.
A conflict on any non-inbox path still fails as today.
A conflict on the inbox file of another item still fails as today.
The audit binding of the code tree holds after the resolve.
The failure digest names the class ship-rebase-conflict, not unknown.
Docs: the ship section in STE; 100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: When a fleet rebase conflicts only on inbox bookkeeping files of the cycle, resolve them mechanically by a stated rule: keep main's stamps and the cycle's consumption. Any other path keeps today's behavior. The code tree is not touched. Emit a signal that names the paths.
source: Wave 154, 2026-11-04. Cycle 2144 (O6) had commit f995309d7 ready. ORCHESTRATOR_FLEET_REBASE_CONFLICT named only .evolve/inbox/...o6...json: the lane changes its own item, and the plane commits chore(inbox) stamps to the same file (718267964). The bookkeeping batch of ADR-0147 D12 removes this race at enforce, and lanes stay at shadow until then. Failure digest class is unknown.
summary: Cycle 2144 passed three audit rounds, and its landing failed only on a conflict with a plane stamp of its own inbox file.
title: A ship rebase conflict on the cycle's own inbox file resolves without an LLM
